products.title: Vibora Yarara Pro Silver 2026 - Vibor-a
products.description:
VIBORA YARARA PRO SILVER 2026 - The renewed Yarara Pro. A magnificent, light, complete racket. Without a doubt one of the most complete models on the market. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The VIBORA YARARA PRO SILVER 2026 is Vibora's new jewel for 2026. New racket with a dark silver aesthetic, very elegant and beautiful. In hybrid form it has a super extensive sweet spot.

PLAYER TYPE

It is a high-performance racket created for professional players looking for a perfect balance between power, control and precision in each stroke.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The characteristics of the VIBORA YARARA PRO SILVER 2026 are:

- hybrid format, very effective to maximize the sweet spot.

- Expanded perforation, for a better hitting sensation and therefore more control.

- 12K carbon fiber as the main protagonist throughout the blade.

- Its professional EVA rubber core provides a reactive but comfortable touch, adapted to those looking for performance without giving up the feeling of play.

- One of its key points is the reinforced bridge, which not only reduces vibrations, but also improves the overall balance of the racket, making each movement more stable and safe.

products.title: Set White Wolf - Set Padel
products.description:
WHITE WOLF SET - We present to you one of the most beautiful Set rackets in the 2026 collection. With its hybrid format, it is a racket that offers a fairly complete game but with more power. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SET WHITE WOLF is probably one of the most wearable options in the Wolf family. Padel racket that responds very well to any game situation thanks to its hybrid format. An aggressive racket, but with very good control.

PLAYER TYPE

We recommend it for players looking for both power and control, but don't want to fall short when it comes time to attack. It fits especially well with a varied game, alternating defense, layups, volleys and more aggressive hits.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Among the materials and technologies we highlight:

The SET WHITE WOLF has a 3K carbon construction and EVA Soft core, a comfortable combination but with enough firmness to accelerate the ball. Its 3D relief finish allows you to play better with spin and completes a racket designed to move easily between control and attack.

products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Asics Sonicsmash Ff White Guava 2026 - Asics
products.description:
ASICS SONICSMASH FF WHITE GUAVA 2026 - Bold design sneakers. A new model, lighter, faster, for players who want extra speed on the court. The new Asics padel shoes in fashion among players are the ASICS SONICSMASH FF WHITE GUAVA 2026, a Premium design model that transmits a modern and sporty image designed for the fast pace of today's padel. Its strong lines and stylized profile reinforce a dynamic aesthetic.

It has advanced technologies, such as the FLYTEFOAM system, a softer and more reactive midsole, which provides excellent cushioning and notable energy return without increasing weight.

Another technology is the so-called SPEEDTRUSS, which gives us a great improvement in stability and response when changing direction.

The good thing about this shoe, and above all, what has been given the most focus this 2026 season is integrating a light and dynamic structure, along with a fabric that provides better interior ventilation.

The herringbone sole with X-GROOVE design guarantees effective grip, great durability and superior flexibility.

products.title: Wilson Optix V2 Lite Lila 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC - Do you want extra lightness? The new Optix Lite offers you a lower weight. Round in shape, it guarantees high control. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC 2026 is the most economical Wilson racket in the 2026 collection. It is a LITE version, lighter and more manageable for a player who is starting out and looking for greater security and comfort. It is a padel racket with a round format and an extensive sweet spot.

PLAYER TYPE

This type of racket is recommended for an intermediate player who plays occasionally and is looking for a light racket with total maneuverability. The Balance of this racket is low and it will help us above all to move it from the bottom. Allows you to react faster.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC 2026 is a racket manufactured with a weight of 355 grams and low balance. In turn, it has a 100% fiberglass composition, both the frame and the planes incorporate this material. It offers greater flexibility than carbon, increasing ball output but reducing hardness.

The core is made of Foam, a low-density foam, with a soft touch, to improve control and ball output as soon as the ball comes into contact with the racket.
